info.title: Socrata API (3.0.0)
info.description:
The Socrata Open Data API (SODA3) provides programmatic access to open data hosted on Socrata-powered portals (now Tyler Technologies Data & Insights).

Every dataset has a unique 4x4 identifier (e.g. `ydr8-5enu`). SODA3 exposes two primary endpoints per dataset:

- **`/query`** — Machine-readable querying via SoQL. Supports pagination, field selection, filtering, grouping, and aggregation.
- **`/export`** — Full-dataset export in human-readable formats (CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, etc.).

Write operations (POST/PUT/DELETE on `/resource/`) use the legacy SODA Producer API path, which remains fully supported.

**Authentication:** All SODA3 query requests require either an `X-App-Token` header or full user authentication (HTTP Basic or OAuth 2.0 Bearer). Write operations require user authentication.

**Base URL:** This spec uses `https://{domain}` as the server — substitute your portal's hostname (e.g. `data.cityofchicago.org`, `soda.demo.socrata.com`).

domain.description: The hostname of your Socrata portal (e.g. data.cityofchicago.org)

tags.name: Query (SODA3)
tags.description: SODA3 `/query` endpoint for machine-readable SoQL queries against a dataset. Supports POST (preferred) and GET. Requires an app token or authentication.

tags.name: Export (SODA3)
tags.description: SODA3 `/export` endpoint for full-dataset downloads in various formats. Supports POST (preferred) and GET.

tags.name: Read Rows (SODA 2.x)
tags.description: Legacy SODA 2.x `/resource/` endpoint for reading rows. Still widely supported and used for backwards compatibility.

tags.name: Write Rows (SODA Producer)
tags.description: SODA Producer API for creating, upserting, replacing, and deleting rows. Requires authentication. Uses the `/resource/` path.

tags.name: Single Row (SODA Producer)
tags.description: Read, update, or delete a single row by its row identifier via the `/resource/` path.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization flow endpoints and current-user lookup.

AppToken.name: X-App-Token
AppToken.description: A Socrata application token. Increases throttling limits. Required for all SODA3 queries (can be combined with authentication).

BasicAuth.description: HTTP Basic Authentication using your Socrata username+password, or an API key ID + secret pair. Must be used over HTTPS.

OAuth2.description: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. Pass as `Authorization: OAuth <access_token>`. Must be used over HTTPS.
